description: Use this when the user asks to make or create a branded report, invoice, summary, release notes, or document — or to 'turn this Markdown/HTML into a PDF and PNG' (optionally with a logo or accent color). Do NOT use to screenshot an existing URL (use rendex_screenshot). Turns Markdown or HTML into a branded, downloadable artifact — a PDF, a PNG, and a hosted share page — in one call. Apply a logo, accentColor, font, header, and footer. Returns hosted URLs { pdfUrl, pngUrl, shareUrl, expiresAt }. Each requested format costs 1 render credit.

accentColor.description: CSS accent color for the bar, links, and headings (e.g. '#EA580C').

content.description: The Markdown or HTML body to render (up to ~4MB).

data.description: Optional Mustache data. When present, content is rendered as a logic-less Mustache template (plus the branding fields as {{logo}}/{{header}}/...) before conversion.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the hosted URLs expire (3600-2592000). Default 86400 (24h).

font.description: CSS font-family stack for the body (e.g. 'Georgia, serif').

footer.description: Plain-text footer line shown at the bottom.

formats.description: Which formats to produce. Each costs 1 credit. Default both.

header.description: Plain-text header line shown beside the logo.

inputFormat.description: How to interpret content. 'markdown' is converted to styled HTML; 'html' is used as a body fragment.

logo.description: Absolute http(s) URL of a logo image shown in the header.

fullPage.description: Capture the full scrollable page for the PNG. Default true.

height.description: PNG viewport height in px. Default 800.

width.description: PNG viewport width in px. Default 1280.

name: render_artifact
title: Render Branded Artifact (PDF + PNG)
